anchor: v1::Hi, this is Ana Kovac. My headlamp on order ORD-20694 showed up with the lens cracked right out of the box. Am I able to get my money back?

result.text: Hi Ana, I'm sorry your headlamp arrived with a cracked lens. I've started a return for order ORD-20694 (return ID RMA-20694) as damaged in transit. Your full refund of $59.00 will go back to you 5–7 business days after the warehouse receives the item.

output.refundTiming: 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
